metadata.baseline: Published 2027/28 BICS forecast: 15.7TWh, allocated within DBT sector bounds. Actual-policy product/site restrictions remain in the baseline; expanded eligibility has no minimum consumption threshold. Additional relief includes currently listed industries.
metadata.source_basis: DUKES broad grid controls, APS/ABS detailed shares reconciled to published baseline floors, sector-specific EEP trends and BRES workplace geography.

excluded_industries.industry_name: Support activities for petroleum and natural gas extraction
Distribution of gaseous fuels through mains

metadata.reference_method_note: Employment is the initial reference for transparency, not a preferred estimator.
metadata.consumption_comparison: Separate 2023-2025 mean-base comparison in consumption_comparison.json; central headlines and geographical ranges retain the latest 2025 base.
metadata.sensitivity: Fixed national reference inputs within each consumption base. Local ranges are the minimum and maximum of employment, regional GVA and regional expenditure allocations only. Separate recent-mean comparison, not artificial national consumption or support bounds; not confidence intervals. National figures are quantified subtotals: unverified sector shares are excluded and identified as not estimated. Remaining industry/territorial allocations are documented proxies.
